product_name: Bajaj Life Group Terminal Illness Rider
regulatory_descriptor: A Group Terminal Illness Rider (attached to a base group policy)
key_benefits: Terminal Illness Benefit: on occurrence of Terminal Illness of the life assured during the base policy term, the Terminal Illness Sum Assured is payable
Company must be informed within 30 days of diagnosis (late claims considered for valid reasons)
Rider can be included from inception or any Annual Renewal Date, and excluded at any Annual Renewal Date

eligibility.policy_term: As per base group policy; cover ceases at the maximum cover-ceasing age allowed under the rider
eligibility.premium_payment_term: As per base policy; Rider Premium collected additionally with the base policy premium
eligibility.note: This is a group rider with no standalone eligibility table in the brochure; entry/cover-ceasing ages and Sum Assured depend on the base group policy and underwriting. Numeric values not present in this parse.

key_terms.free_look_note: Same as the base product, but applicable from the Date of Commencement of the Rider if different from the base policy's Date of Commencement of Risk.
key_terms.grace_period: As per base policy. On occurrence of Terminal Illness during the grace period, the benefit is payable subject to deduction of due-but-unpaid rider premium.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: There is NO maturity benefit under the rider; on exclusion, no surrender value with respect to the rider is payable.
key_terms.terminal_illness_definition: An advanced or rapidly progressing incurable disease where, in the opinion of two appropriate independent Medical Practitioners, life expectancy is no greater than six (6) months from the date of notification of claim; insured must not be receiving treatment other than palliative medication.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits as per applicable tax laws.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Free-look period disclosure (linked to base policy)

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a RIDER attached to a base group policy — it cannot be marketed as a standalone product or as life cover on its own.

The Terminal Illness benefit is payable only on a Terminal Illness as strictly defined (incurable disease, life expectancy <= 6 months confirmed by two Medical Practitioners) — any claim must reflect this definition.
Benefit is conditional on rider premium being paid and the base policy/membership being in force.
If the accelerated Terminal Illness benefit equals the death benefit, the rider terminates — it is not always additional to the death benefit.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position this rider as an investment, savings, maturity or money-back benefit — there is no maturity benefit and no surrender value.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — it is a non-linked, non-participating pure-protection rider.
Do NOT imply the Terminal Illness benefit pays out for any serious illness — only the strict Terminal Illness definition applies.
Do NOT market it independently of a base group policy.
must_state: That this is a Group Terminal Illness Rider attached to a base group policy (not a standalone plan)
The Terminal Illness definition / claim conditions
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document for full terms and exclusions
